## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      7 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 24 июл. 2026 г. - 28 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Rashika Rampersad_, 27 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "The new version of the app is definitely not user friendly. The UX and UI is not usable. The app has so many bugs where syncing is not happening accurately pages take more than 1 min to load, probably because they so content heavy and step targets change constantly when its set at 10 000. Do better and sort out your bugs and syncing issues."
            2. _Daniel Baumbart_, 27 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "202609: app doesn't crash a lot anymore but I can't delete wrong automatic entries in sleep so the data is wrong and will get worse over time :( 202509: crashes a lot since the newest update"
            3. _JWM B_, 24 июл. 2026 г., 1/5: "Terrible update, completely ruined the app. Since the latest Samsung Health update, this app has gone downhill fast. The new UI is cluttered and confusing, and honestly feels like a step backward instead of an improvement. Worse, the app crashes constantly, which makes my Samsung Watch practically useless for sports and training. I rely on this thing for tracking workouts, and now I can't trust it to even stay open. This is three steps back, not progress. Really disappointing!"
<!--/ir-theme-->
